title: Machine learning selects W-doped nickel–iron oxyhydroxide for electrolysis
summary: EquiformerV2-based interatomic predictions screened 3,976 configurations and guided W1–NiFeOOH selection. The journal reports 13.1 A cm−2 at 2.0 V and 80 °C in one anion-exchange-membrane electrolyzer test, and a separate >500-hour test at 1 A cm−2 and 60 °C. Conditions are distinct laboratory tests and are not evidence of commercial scale. The publisher lists 29 January 2026 as the publication date and 11 March 2026 as the version-of-record date.

evidence.tested: Publisher primary indexed article reports tested W1–NiFeOOH, high-current-density and separate durability results.
evidence.unknown: A dataset deposited 2026-01-10 predates the paper; its preview was inaccessible, so earliest disclosure of the specific result is unresolved. Training overlap and independent replication remain open.
evidence.ai_role: Interatomic model predicts stability/adsorption properties to screen catalyst configurations before synthesis and electrolysis tests.

source_review.scope: Indexed publisher article, including bibliographic dates, abstract and electrolyzer results
